notice.directive: Seek emergency department assessment now. Do not wait for a message reply; call 911 if you cannot travel safely.

event.text: Go to the emergency department now. Blood sugar over 400 with vomiting and not being able to keep water down can mean a dangerous diabetic emergency needing IV fluids and blood tests today. Have someone drive you, or call 911 if you feel faint, confused, drowsy, or short of breath, or if vomiting continues on the way. Don't wait for a message reply.
